name: letters
title: Letters
description: A newsletter and essay theme in book serif on cool paper white with one sealing-wax red accent, whose signature is the archive: every essay set like a line in a book's table of contents, dot-leadered out to its date and numbered while the archive fits on one page.

tokens.--font-serif: the one typeface: body text, headings, the site title, the numbers in the archive
tokens.--text-s: small capital lines: the menu, dates, tags, the footer
tokens.--text-m: body text size (generous, for long reading)
tokens.--text-l: archive entry titles, subtitles, small headings
tokens.--text-xl: the site title and headings inside an essay
tokens.--text-xxl: the big title at the top of each page
tokens.--text-code: size of code relative to the text around it
tokens.--leading-tight: line spacing of titles and archive entries
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the small capital lines
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: dates, subtitles, excerpts, the footer, the edge of the e-mail field
tokens.--color-wax: the sealing-wax red: links, the archive numbers, the seal by the site title and at the end of an essay, the subscribe card's top rule and button
tokens.--color-on-wax: text placed on the wax red (the subscribe button)
tokens.--color-border: hairline rules: under the menu, around the subscribe card, in tables
tokens.--color-leader: the dot leaders in the archive and the bar beside a quotation
tokens.--measure: maximum width of the text column
tokens.--toc-gutter: width of the number column in the archive
tokens.--leader-step: distance from one leader dot to the next
tokens.--seal: size of the wax seal beside the site title and at the end of an essay
tokens.--field-width: width of the e-mail field in the subscribe card
tokens.--space-1: hairbreadth gap: between an archive title and its excerpt
tokens.--space-2: small gap: between a title and its subtitle, around menu links, inside buttons
tokens.--space-3: page side padding, the gap between paragraphs, the gap between archive entries
tokens.--space-4: gap between sections, between menu items, inside the subscribe card
tokens.--space-5: the air above the site title, above each page title and above the subscribe card
tokens.--rule: thickness of hairline rules, underlines and field edges
tokens.--rule-heavy: thickness of the wax rule across the top of the subscribe card
tokens.--radius: corner rounding for images, code, the subscribe card and its field
